card.name: Separators inside number lists
card.fires_on: Commas, decimal points and fraction symbols inside strings of digits, such as lists of doses, section numbers or large figures. It fires where a number is broken by a separator and more digits are expected.

modes.label: Commas in digit strings
modes.description: A comma inside a long number or a list of numbers without spaces.

modes.label: Decimal points in dose lists
modes.description: A decimal point after 0 in a list of tested doses.

modes.label: Fraction symbols in tables
modes.description: A fraction character in a dosing table.

card.plain: It marks the commas and decimal points inside lists of numbers, as in dose lists and section references.
